snippet.title: World War Z VR - Swarm Trailer
snippet.description:
The swarms are approaching… Challenge the odds by facing hundreds of zombies on screen at a time! 🧟📈

Choose your tactics to defeat special infected and explore TEN maps across three episodes in full VR locomotion mode. 🥽🌐

World War Z VR is coming on August 12. 🗓

Pre-order now to unlock the Golden Skin Pack bonus featuring four exclusive gold weapon skins! 🔫✨
Meta Quest - https://sabr.gg/4kLnPbK
SteamVR - https://sabr.gg/4kHnqXx
